title: Eneo Flows runs reliably and remains easy to change
description:
TL;DR: Make Eneo Flow proper safe to operate in production and straightforward to change without creating parallel ownership with Flow AI Builder. This epic owns Flow runtime, persistence, API/client, UI, retention, health, recovery, and maintainability work; AI Builder internals remain out of scope.

## Success Criteria

- Authored secrets never persist plaintext, and existing exposure has a recovery path.
- Retention semantics match actual run payload, artifact, file, audit, and deletion behavior.
- Run recovery, external delivery, publication concurrency, worker health, and dead-letter recovery have explicit tested outcomes.
- Canonical owners replace duplicate validation, status, evidence, and frontend state paths without generic new layers.
- Flow AI Builder consumes stabilized Flow contracts through a coordinated baseline rather than conflicting edits.
- Each implementation slice has behavior/contract tests, rollback or recovery notes, and a reviewable deletion/consolidation boundary.
